key: What's someone like you doin' in these parts?
en: What's someone like you doin' in these parts?
ja: あんたみたいなのが、こんな場所で何やってんだ?

key: Watch yourself now.
en: Watch yourself now.
ja: ウェイン: 気をつけろよ、今のうちにな。

key: I wouldn't come here if I had anywhere else to be.
en: I wouldn't come here if I had anywhere else to be.
ja: 他に行くとこがあるなら、こんなとこには来ないけどな。

key: This gate leads to the Byxbysion Wasteland.
en: This gate leads to the Byxbysion Wasteland.
ja: この門はビクスビジョン荒地へと続いている。

key: Such a rank place.
en: Such a rank place.
ja: ひどく荒れ果てた場所だ。

key: Debris from across the region appears there without explanation.
en: Debris from across the region appears there without explanation.
ja: 地方各地からのがれきが、理由もなくあそこに現れるんだ。

key: They're right to keep it locked up.
en: They're right to keep it locked up.
ja: 封鎖しておくのは正しい判断だな。

key: Hello? How am I going to go shopping if they won't let us in the Obsidia Ward?
en: Hello? How am I going to go shopping if they won't let us in the Obsidia Ward?
ja: ちょっと、オブシディアワードに入れてもらえなかったら、どうやって買い物すればいいの?

key: Salon de Glamazonia
en: Salon de Glamazonia
ja: サロン・ド・グラマゾニア

key: An advertisement is plastered on the wall...
en: An advertisement is plastered on the wall...
ja: 壁に広告が貼られている…

key: "The amazing Agate Circus!
en: "The amazing Agate Circus!
ja: 「驚異のアゲートサーカス!

key: Featuring carnies, clowns and chaos!
en: Featuring carnies, clowns and chaos!
ja: 見世物師、道化師、そして大混乱!

key: Now with the famed Agate Ace Triumvirate!
en: Now with the famed Agate Ace Triumvirate!
ja: 今なら、名高きアゲート・エース三頭政もご登場!

key: Take the challenge and face off against three Reborn League Leaders in a spectacular showcase smack- down!
en: Take the challenge and face off against three Reborn League Leaders in a spectacular showcase smack- down!
ja: リボーンリーグの三人のジムリーダーに挑戦し、壮大なショーの中でぶつかり合え!

key: Just west of Agate City!
en: Just west of Agate City!
ja: アゲートシティのすぐ西で!

key: Hey, man, got any "Rare Candies"?
en: Hey, man, got any "Rare Candies"?
ja: なあ、「ふしぎなアメ」とか持ってねえか?

key: I'm jonesin'...
en: I'm jonesin'...
ja: カーター: 禁断症状が出てんだよ…

key: Gotta get my fix, man...
en: Gotta get my fix, man...
ja: どうしても欲しいんだよ…

key: CAIN: I can't say Victoria's wrong...
en: CAIN: I can't say Victoria's wrong...
ja: カイン: ヴィクトリアが間違ってるとは言えないな…

key: I'm hesitating.
en: I'm hesitating.
ja: でも俺、迷ってる。

key: Obviously I don't want anything to happen to them.
en: Obviously I don't want anything to happen to them.
ja: あの子たちに何かあってほしくないのは当然だし。

key: I'm not heartless.
en: I'm not heartless.
ja: 冷たい人間ってわけじゃないんだ。

key: But it wasn't exactly a warm and fuzzy environment.
en: But it wasn't exactly a warm and fuzzy environment.
ja: でも、あそこは決して居心地のいい場所じゃなかった。

key: I don't want to go back there.
en: I don't want to go back there.
ja: あそこにはもう戻りたくない。

key: CAIN: ...Still, we have to, right?
en: CAIN: ...Still, we have to, right?
ja: カイン: …それでも、行かなきゃだよね?

key: CAIN: There. The gate's open for all now.
en: CAIN: There. The gate's open for all now.
ja: カイン: よし。これで門はみんなに開かれた。

key: If only it would've held Team Meteor in the first place.
en: If only it would've held Team Meteor in the first place.
ja: そもそもこれでミート団を閉じ込めておけてればよかったのにな。

key: CAIN: ...No more hesitating.
en: CAIN: ...No more hesitating.
ja: カイン: …もう迷ってる場合じゃない。

key: Better do everything we can.
en: Better do everything we can.
ja: できることは全部やろう。

key: ...And better hope it's enough.
en: ...And better hope it's enough.
ja: …それで足りることを祈るしかないね。

key: CAL: \PN?
en: CAL: \PN?
ja: キャル: \PN?

key: CAL: Hi.
en: CAL: Hi.
ja: キャル: よお。

key: Look, I know you have every reason to hate me, but hear me out.
en: Look, I know you have every reason to hate me, but hear me out.
ja: なあ、君が俺を憎む理由なら山ほどあるってわかってる。でも聞いてくれ。

key: Please believe that I never meant for this to happen.
en: Please believe that I never meant for this to happen.
ja: こんな結果になるつもりはなかったんだ、信じてほしい。

key: Kiki never would have--
en: Kiki never would have--
ja: キキがこんなことになるなんて――

key: I didn't go to Apophyll to infiltrate it for Team Meteor.
en: I didn't go to Apophyll to infiltrate it for Team Meteor.
ja: ミート団のためにアポフィルに潜入しようとして行ったわけじゃないんだ。

key: I really did want to change.
en: I really did want to change.
ja: 本当に変わりたかった。

key: And-- I did.
en: And-- I did.
ja: それに――実際に変われた。

key: I think...
en: I think...
ja: …と思う。

key: It feels like every time I finally get on track, something else happens to kick me off of it.
en: It feels like every time I finally get on track, something else happens to kick me off of it.
ja: やっと軌道に乗ったと思うたびに、また別の何かが起きて弾き出される気がするんだ。

key: Team Meteor found out where I was, so they gave me orders to set up the PULSE.
en: Team Meteor found out where I was, so they gave me orders to set up the PULSE.
ja: ミート団に居場所がばれて、パルスを設置しろって命令されたんだ。

key: You all and Kiki tried so hard to stop it...
en: You all and Kiki tried so hard to stop it...
ja: 君たちもキキも、それを止めようと必死に頑張った…

key: ...But I had sabotaged the machine in the first place.
en: ...But I had sabotaged the machine in the first place.
ja: …でも実は、俺が最初からあの機械に細工してたんだ。

key: I didn't want anyone to get hurt.
en: I didn't want anyone to get hurt.
ja: 誰も傷つけたくなかった。

key: I liked that place.
en: I liked that place.
ja: あの場所が好きだった。

key: So I secretly broke the PULSE when I installed it.
en: So I secretly broke the PULSE when I installed it.
ja: だから設置する時、こっそりパルスを壊しておいたんだ。

key: Ripped the entire cooling system.
en: Ripped the entire cooling system.
ja: 冷却システムを丸ごと引き裂いた。

key: Kiki didn't have to die.
en: Kiki didn't have to die.
ja: キキが死ぬ必要なんてなかったんだ。

key: The Medicham--
en: The Medicham--
ja: あのチャーレムは――

key: It's not what you think.
en: It's not what you think.
ja: 君が思ってるようなことじゃない。

key: But I'm so sorry that it happened this way.
en: But I'm so sorry that it happened this way.
ja: でも、こんな形になってしまって本当にすまない。

key: Do you believe me?
en: Do you believe me?
ja: 信じてくれるか?

key: CAL: I appreciate your mercy.
en: CAL: I appreciate your mercy.
ja: キャル: 情けをかけてくれて感謝するよ。

key: It's almost more than I deserve.
en: It's almost more than I deserve.
ja: 俺には過ぎたものだ。

key: And I don't expect anyone from Apophyll will listen to me.
en: And I don't expect anyone from Apophyll will listen to me.
ja: アポフィルの誰かが俺の話を聞いてくれるなんて、期待してない。

key: Especially not Victoria.
en: Especially not Victoria.
ja: 特にヴィクトリアはな。

key: CAL: I guess that's the predictable answer.
en: CAL: I guess that's the predictable answer.
ja: キャル: まあ、予想通りの答えだよな。

key: Victoria would say the same, I'm sure.
en: Victoria would say the same, I'm sure.
ja: ヴィクトリアもきっと同じこと言うよ。

key: ...And, there's one more thing.
en: ...And, there's one more thing.
ja: …それと、もうひとつある。

key: CAL: I... had to steal that in order to haul the machinery up there.
en: CAL: I... had to steal that in order to haul the machinery up there.
ja: キャル: 俺は…あそこに機材を運び上げるために、それを盗まなきゃならなかった。

key: I regretted it immediately.
en: I regretted it immediately.
ja: すぐに後悔した。

key: Even more when I found out--
en: Even more when I found out--
ja: それに、知った時はもっと――

key: Team Meteor is holding Shelly.
en: Team Meteor is holding Shelly.
ja: ミート団がシェリーを捕らえてる。

key: I want to charge in there, break her out, and tear them a new one.
en: I want to charge in there, break her out, and tear them a new one.
ja: あそこに乗り込んで彼女を助け出して、あいつらをぶちのめしたい。

key: ...But I won't.
en: ...But I won't.
ja: …でもやらない。

key: I have to find a way to be better than my fears and impulses.
en: I have to find a way to be better than my fears and impulses.
ja: 自分の恐れや衝動より、もっとましな自分になる方法を見つけなきゃいけないんだ。

key: So, I'm going to make myself scarce.
en: So, I'm going to make myself scarce.
ja: だから、俺は姿を消すことにするよ。

key: They'll be after me, too, now that they know I betrayed them.
en: They'll be after me, too, now that they know I betrayed them.
ja: 裏切ったことがばれた以上、あいつらも俺を追ってくるだろうしな。

key: I'm counting on you to save her in my place.
en: I'm counting on you to save her in my place.
ja: 俺の代わりに彼女を救い出してくれると信じてる。

key: I know it's my fault that half of this happened,
en: I know it's my fault that half of this happened,
ja: 半分は俺のせいでこうなったってわかってる、

key: But please help make it right.
en: But please help make it right.
ja: でも、どうかこれを正すのを手伝ってくれ。

key: Maybe we'll meet again some day.
en: Maybe we'll meet again some day.
ja: いつかまた会えるかもな。

key: Maybe it's best we don't.
en: Maybe it's best we don't.
ja: 会わない方がいいのかもしれないけど。

en: > - Lilycove Street\n^ - 10th Street
ja: > - ミナモ通り\n^ - 10番街

en: > - Jubilife Street\n^v - 10th Street
ja: > - トバリ通り\n^v - 10番街

en: < - Jubilife Street\n^v - 11th Street
ja: < - トバリ通り\n^v - 11番街

key: My home has been ruined by the plants...
en: My home has been ruined by the plants...
ja: わしの家は植物にめちゃくちゃにされちまった…

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this foul storm...?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this foul storm...?
ja: 家を失って、この酷い嵐の中で行く当てもない老人に、小銭を恵んでくれんかね…?

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this miserable heat?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this miserable heat?
ja: 家を失って、この惨めな暑さの中で行く当てもない老人に、小銭を恵んでくれんかね?

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to take shelter?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to take shelter?
ja: 家を失って、雨風をしのぐ場所もない老人に、小銭を恵んでくれんかね?

key: Mommy, where are you?
en: Mommy, where are you?
ja: ママ、どこにいるの?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
